title: Revisiting Proxima with ESPRESSO
what_was_studied: 63 observations of Proxima in 2019 with joint RV and activity modelling
numerical_result: Typical photon-noise uncertainty was 0.26 m/s; ESPRESSO-only modelling recovered Proxima b at 11.218 plus or minus 0.029 days
remaining_question: Photon uncertainty is not the residual stellar scatter and the activity model remains part of the inference

title: ESPRESSO at VLT: On-sky performance and first results
what_was_studied: Instrument architecture, commissioning, throughput and stable-star sequences
numerical_result: Throughput exceeded 10% at 550 nm in the stated conditions; RV precision was better than 0.25 m/s in one night and 0.50 m/s over several months
remaining_question: The authors interpret the measurements as compatible with 0.10 m/s instrumental precision rather than demonstrating 0.10 m/s on every star

title: Towards an accurate ESPRESSO wavelength calibration
what_was_studied: Independent extraction and comparison of ThAr plus Fabry-Perot and laser-comb wavelength solutions
numerical_result: The paper maps structured wavelength differences and distinguishes accuracy requirements for fundamental-constant and differential-RV work
remaining_question: Internal calibrators do not independently test the complete telescope-to-product light path

title: Fundamental physics with ESPRESSO: a new constraint on alpha
what_was_studied: Laser-comb calibrated quasar absorption spectrum used to test variation of the fine-structure constant
numerical_result: The comb covered about 485 to 700 nm while the full instrument range was about 378 to 778 nm
remaining_question: Accuracy for quasar line separations and repeatability for stellar differential RVs are related but different requirements

title: Detection of solar-like oscillations in the K5 dwarf epsilon Indi
what_was_studied: High-cadence ESPRESSO velocities used to detect stellar oscillations
numerical_result: After nightly high-pass filtering the series had 0.30 m/s RMS versus a mean 0.22 m/s photon uncertainty
remaining_question: Filtering and a short asteroseismic sequence do not establish long-period planet sensitivity

title: Validation of the ESPRESSO wavelength calibration using iodine absorption cell spectra
what_was_studied: Temporary iodine cell and forward model used to test the science light path against internal calibration
numerical_result: The study reports wavelength accuracy at a few m/s and end-to-end RV stability below 0.20 m/s in its stated experiment
remaining_question: Stability and absolute wavelength accuracy are different; injection geometry affected measured wavelengths

title: ESPRESSO laser-frequency-comb operational notices
what_was_studied: Dated record of comb interruption, background variability, recovery and current use
numerical_result: ESO states the LFC returned to full operations in November 2025; the May 2026 manual update describes recent changes and current performance
remaining_question: Queue availability does not erase earlier non-Gaussian background or replace experiment-specific validation
